method: Both Qwen3.5-4B VLM and Qwen3-1.7B reasoner use physical prefill64 versus16; same original BF16/FP32 kernels and shared weights. Separate from rejected VLM-only WS07.
hypothesis: Larger chunks may reduce repeated weight reads in both model stages. WS07 found useful VLM gain but text-stage regression; no causal claim for that regression.
tradeoffs: Both chunk-keyed graph sets kept warm for ablation, larger activation/cache footprint and padding; measure memory provenance, do not call RSS peakGPU.
stage: Native/reference and all-layer state/token equivalence for BOTH models before WorldSense single-car ABBA screen, four samples/policy/model; no promotion without fresh full three-frame/search mirrored workers.
